global_sequence_description: Surveillance footage of a computer hardware aisle where a synthetic subject inspects a small electronic component and places it back onto the shelf.

chronological_sequence_segments.scene_description: The subject stands in the aisle holding a white plastic shopping bag in their left hand, while holding and inspecting a small square component box in their right hand.
The subject turns their upper body to the left, reaching out with their right arm to place the small box back onto the metal display shelf.
The subject lets go of the box, drops their right arm naturally to their side, and rotates their torso back toward the center of the aisle to walk away.
